items.prompt: REDESIGN the attached Re:Zero Return by Death card illustration to make the WITCH OF ENVY unmistakably present and the image dramatically richer. Use attachment as Subaru character likeness, tracksuit and original Re:Zero 2D anime style reference; composition and lighting should be entirely redesigned. Preserve original natural anime character proportions, original costumes, sharp emotional expressive cel shading and meticulous 2D anime illustration, NOT chibi, NOT 3D or live action. One coherent square full-bleed scene without panels. Natsuki Subaru in the lower-central foreground, recognizable short spiky black hair, expressive scared wide eyes, black white and orange sports tracksuit, one trembling normal human hand clutching the fabric over his chest, breath caught, sweating lightly, desperately determined rather than a confident spell-caster. His face stays clearly visible and dominates foreground. Behind and above him looms the large ominous SILHOUETTE OF SATELLA, the Witch of Envy: long flowing SILVER hair, BLACK flowing dress and BLACK VEIL, ethereal shadowed face with a faint violet eye under veil, never Emilia's white-purple outfit. Her veiled form and silver hair occupy upper center/right, as if leaning close to Subaru, with the black gown dissolving into dark violet smoke. Several long slender black SHADOW HANDS with distinct five-finger silhouettes emerge from the lower sides and behind her, curving around Subaru in a possessive enclosing gesture, one ghostlike shadow palm reaching toward his chest. Layer midnight black, indigo, violet backlight and red heart accent; iridescent purple edges define shadow hands and silhouette while cold light keeps Subaru's eyes readable. Rich directional light, shadow tendrils, hair strands, drifting purple motes and depth, dramatic tension, clear separation of foreground and witch. items.prompt: REDESIGN the attached Konosuba game card illustration into the ACTUAL CLIMAX OF EXPLOSION MAGIC.
